name: Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling - Downey Production Plant, CA

fieldNotes.location: Roster names this the 'Downey Production Plant' but supplied address '12320 Smith Ave, Santa Fe Springs CA 90670' with coords (33.9489,-118.0727). That address/coords land on a generic warehouse street in Santa Fe Springs with no Coca-Cola signage. Web/business research (Buzzfile, OpenGovUS LA business registry) gives the Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling Downey manufacturing address as 11634 Patton Rd, Downey CA 90241. Satellite probing of that location revealed a large bottling/distribution complex, and Street View confirmed it: Coca-Cola red branding stripe on the building plus Coca-Cola-branded red trailers parked inside the fenced yard.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The plant perimeter is fully secured - masonry walls and chain-link fencing topped with barbed wire. The truck yard is entered through a chain-link rolling/sliding gate (seen open in Street View) - controlled truck gate confirmed. truckGate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth observed at the truck rolling gate; recorded guardShack false. Flagged uncertain - a booth may sit at another entrance out of Street View coverage.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present without a confirmed staffed booth implies kiosk/remote check-in - recorded remoteGs true (flagged uncertain).
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least two gated truck entrances counted in the walled perimeter; recorded 2.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple gated entrances at different points of the walled perimeter - in/out movement split - entryExitSeparate true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~55 dock doors across multiple building faces with trailers backed in; banded 50+. Flagged uncertain - several dock faces partly obscured by trailers and rooftop angle.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large trailer drop yards (one on the rail/north side, one on the south side) hold ~80 trailers total in rows; banded 50+. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks appear on physically separate building faces (north/rail side and south side) - shipRcvSeparate true.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the north edge of the property and a spur appears to serve the site - railServed true.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large internal paved yards between the gates and the docks give deep staging room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep internal approach holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large multi-building complex - main production/warehouse building, additional connected warehouses, and an office/support building.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.

citations.claim: Downey named as one of three current CA locations where Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling manufactures (Downey, LA, San Leandro)

verification.rationale: Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling-operated CA production plant (Downey); named as a current CA manufacturing site in 2023.
